title: Smoked mackerel on toast with sticky plums

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain home staple, and horseradish sauce and smoked mackerel are traditional British cupboard and fridge items.

supermarket.reason: Smoked mackerel, plums, watercress, crème fraîche and wholemeal bread are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a toaster or grill and a bowl, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: Quantities suit four slices for breakfast, and a short cook of plums with onion, vinegar and a little sugar will give soft, glossy fruit that balances the rich fish.

honest_times.reason: Slicing the onion, stoning the plums and flaking the mackerel fit around the 8 to 9 minutes of pan time, so 15 minutes is believable at a quick pace.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient appears in the steps, the steps use nothing unlisted, and 'Wholemeal bread' matches the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early September plums are central to the dish, paired with smoked mackerel, and a warm toast suits the date.

plain_voice.reason: It is clear, friendly British English with easy steps and no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with oily fish, fruit and watercress is a satisfying, balanced breakfast a family would happily repeat.
